mat.purpose: Page, nav bar, tab bar and sheet ground.

plate.purpose: Cards, lists, form groups, rack, results.

control.purpose: Secondary buttons, inputs inside cards, rack-number tags, pressed rows.

rail.purpose: Rack bar and hooks, future-day rings, scrollbar.

race-blue.purpose: Race bib band, today, primary action, interactive tint, focus.

on-race-blue.purpose: Text and icons on race blue.

bib-ink-secondary.purpose: Secondary text on the empty bib.

themes.name: light
themes.selector: html[data-theme="light"], or prefers-color-scheme: light when no data-theme is set
themes.note: Same world on a light mat; deeper blue and darker cap colours for contrast. Values in colorMeta.*.light.

display.purpose: Days-to-race figure on the race bib only.

title.purpose: Nav bar title, uppercase; 20px centred in sheets.

body.purpose: Inputs, menu items, sentences. Never below 16px for inputs.

meta.purpose: Secondary row text, comparisons, empty-state copy.

fonts.source: Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com), runtime-cached by the service worker (sw.js FONT_HOSTS).
fonts.openItem: Self-hosting the fonts is pending the owner's decision.

components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid var(--separator, #2E3338); background: var(--bg, #111315); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 8px 0 6px; min-height: 52px; background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-tertiary, #80878E); font-family: var(--font-figure, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-secondary, #A3A9AF); } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--accent, #5B7CFF); } .ds-tab-primary { flex: 0 0 64px; align-self: center; height: 46px; margin: 4px 2px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: var(--accent, #5B7CFF); color: var(--on-accent, #111315); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-tab-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5B7CFF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-bib { position: relative; background: var(--bib, #F4F5F6); color: var(--bib-ink, #15171A); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 22px 0; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bib::before, .ds-bib::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 8px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg, #111315); } .ds-bib::before { left: 8px; } .ds-bib::after { right: 8px; } .ds-bib:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5B7CFF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-bib-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-figure, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-bib-num { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin: 2px 0 10px; font-family: var(--font-figure, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); } .ds-bib-num .n { font-size: 96px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bib-num .u { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-bib-band { margin: 0 -22px; padding: 9px 22px; background: var(--accent, #5B7CFF); color: var(--on-accent, #111315); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-text, 'Barlow', -apple-system, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-rack { background: var(--bg-card, #1B1E21); border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 8px 10px; } .ds-slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); background: linear-gradient(var(--rail, #3A4046), var(--rail, #3A4046)) no-repeat 6px 17px / calc(100% - 12px) 3px; } .ds-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-height: 100px; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5B7CFF); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-no { font-family: var(--font-figure, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 18px; min-width: 22px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--control-bg, #2A2E33); color: var(--text-secondary, #A3A9AF); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-bottom: 1px; } .ds-slot:hover .ds-no { color: var(--text, #F2F1EC); } .ds-today .ds-no, .ds-today:hover .ds-no { background: var(--accent, #5B7CFF); color: var(--on-accent, #111315); } .ds-hook { width: 2px; height: 12px; background: var(--rail, #3A4046); } .ds-caps { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-cap { border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-future { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--rail, #3A4046); } .ds-day { font-family: var(--font-figure, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-secondary, #A3A9AF); text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-today .ds-day { color: var(--text, #F2F1EC); }

narrative.overview:
The app is a triathlon transition zone at dusk. The ground is a near-black rubber mat; content sits on slightly raised charcoal plates; the week is a bike rack with seven numbered slots; every session is a latex swim cap in its sport's colour, sized by volume. The next race is a white paper start number pinned to the top of the Woche screen. One race blue marks the race, today, and whatever you can press.

It is a dense, one-handed tool, not a dashboard of grey tiles. Figures are big, heavy and condensed so they read at arm's length in a gym or outdoors; prose stays in a plain sans. Surfaces are flat. Colour carries data (which sport) and intent (blue = act / now / race), never decoration. The rejected reference is the stock iOS grouped-tile dashboard with system blue.

Dark is the default scene. A daylight variant keeps the same world on a light-grey mat with white plates, a deeper blue, and darker cap colours for contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Rubber-mat ground, charcoal plates, hairline rails; no shadows at rest.
Four sport cap colours used only as data marks.
One accent, race blue, for race, today and interaction.
Barlow Condensed uppercase for figures and labels, Barlow for text, tabular numerals throughout.
Solid = done, dashed = missed, small hollow ring = still to come.
Portrait phone column, max 560px, thumb-zone primary action in the tab bar.

rules.name: The Caps Are Data Rule
rules.body: Sport colours appear only on marks that stand for a sport (caps, dots, badges, picker selection). Never on chrome, buttons or headings.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Race blue is the only accent. It means the race, today, or "press here". No second accent colour exists, and system blue is never used.

rules.name: The Condensed Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number, day abbreviation and uppercase label is Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals (`.figure` utility); every sentence is Barlow, sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Plates Rule
rules.body: Cards, lists, the rack and the bib carry no shadow. If something needs to read as "above", it uses the raised plate tone, and a shadow only when it floats over other content.

dos: Do mark state by line form: solid filled cap = done, dashed ring = nothing logged, small hollow rail ring = still ahead.
Do use race blue for the race, today, and the thing to press, with mat-coloured text on it in dark mode.
Do set every figure in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, and keep body text and inputs at 16px.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and route each screen's main action through the single tab-bar "+".
Do use the daylight variant's darker cap and blue values in light mode; never reuse the dark-mode cap colours on white.
Do separate rows with 1px hairlines inside a plate rather than spacing plates apart.
donts: Don't build the iOS grey-tile dashboard or use system blue.
Don't colour buttons, headings or chrome with a sport colour.
Don't add a second accent colour or a blue gradient.
Don't put shadows on resting plates, cards, the rack or the bib.
Don't add a floating action button over content; the primary action lives in the tab bar.
Don't block browser zoom (the viewport allows scaling; keep it that way).

Don't treat the Google Fonts dependency as settled: Barlow and Barlow Condensed are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com and runtime-cached by the service worker; self-hosting them is an open decision for the owner.
